description: This file is part of the TestLink open source test management project. It handles web-based operations for assigning and unassigning requirement test cases within test projects and test suites. Functions include processing user requests, performing bulk assignments of requirements to test cases, and rendering respective templates, facilitating management of test requirements linkage.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class managing test project operations, including hierarchy management and requirement specification generation.

classes.name: requirement_spec_mgr
classes.description: Manager class for handling requirement specifications, including retrieval of latest requirement versions.

classes.name: requirement_mgr
classes.description: Handles requirement management, including bulk assignment and linking requirements to test cases.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Provides test case retrieval, version status, and related operations.

classes.name: testsuite
classes.description: Manages test suite data and operations, including retrieving associated test cases.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments for processing.

methods.name: processTestSuite
methods.description: Prepares test suite context for managing requirement test case assignments.

methods.name: doBulkAssignment
methods.description: Performs bulk assignment of requirements to test cases within a test suite.

methods.name: doSingleTestCaseOperation
methods.description: Performs specific operations (assign/unassign) on individual test cases based on user input.

methods.name: processTestCase
methods.description: Prepares detailed view and context for a single test case, including requirement linkage.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes GUI context object with user and requirement settings.

methods.name: getTargetTestCases
methods.description: Retrieves list of test case IDs for operations within a test suite.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies user permissions to access or modify requirement-testcase linkages.
